text: **So my earlier "shell is the wildcard for huge deletion" was wrong** — there isn't much shell to delete because there isn't much shell. That revises the campaign estimate down: net deletion is **Rust-dominated (~10k–25k net)** plus modest shell — call it **~12k–30k net total**, concentrated in collapsing duplicate per-feature lifecycle wiring in `nmp-core`/runtimes. The win remains concept/surface reduction, not raw LOC.
